title: Jereh's three ADNOC Onshore awards are letters of award; formal contracts not yet signed
publisher: SaudiGulf Projects / MEED (read from search summaries)
note: Research 24 Nov: Jereh's Shenzhen filing of 4 Nov describes letters of award for three ADNOC Onshore projects worth about $2.7bn (AED9.9bn); formal contracts were not yet signed. The three include Ruwais Diyab (a design, build and operate contract, per MEED sources; ADNOC took FID on 2-3 Nov) and Bab / North East Bab onshore facilities. MEED separately reports a $392m (AED1.44bn) EPC award to Jereh for wellhead surface facilities; whether it is one of the three is unconfirmed.

title: Local firm wins Adnoc Gas project detailed engineering works: 56-inch, 127km gas pipeline (winner not named)
note: Research 24 Nov: the work is detailed engineering for a 56-inch, 127km pipeline that will supply gas to phase two of an AI data centre in Abu Dhabi and support the relocation of Ewec's power assets in Mirfa. The winning local firm is named only in MEED's paid article.

title: Bab gas cap well tie-ins: 18 EPC packages, bids extended again
note: Research 24 Nov: the tie-in scope is split into 18 EPC packages; MEED has put the budget at $800m-plus and, in an earlier report, $1.2bn. MEED reported on 27 Oct that contractors were selected for a 'Bab and North East Bab One' tie-in project, without naming them; it is unconfirmed whether that is the same tender. No bidders named in free sources.
